verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs show a framework software stack on its data-center GPUs. That stack includes NGC GPU-optimized AI containers and application frameworks, cuML running scikit-learn/UMAP/HDBSCAN code on GPUs unchanged, TensorRT-LLM, and the NVIDIA AI Enterprise subscription. However, none of it names PyTorch or ties officially documented builds or a support matrix specifically to the H200. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX support on H200, a published framework or CUDA support matrix covering H200, independent or hands-on confirmation of framework builds running on H200.
